arguments.title: How to book a company car

blocks.text:
1) Open the booking page on the intranet.
2) Choose the dates and the car.
3) Wait for the approval of your manager.
4) Collect the keys at reception.
5) Return the car with a full tank.
Fines are charged to the driver.
